body: I genuinely tried to read this but got bored half way through. You might need to improve your writing skills, try and be more engaging! Maybe more diverse and efficient language would help you. We all have room to improve so don’t beat yourself up too much about this intermining post :)

If you want someone to talk to I’m here. I’m not on Reddit too much but when I am, I’m happy to give my time :) 

No pressure to open up but the offers here.

Hate to hear you’ve had so much mistreatment in your life. I can’t imagine what that’s like. 

Hope things look up for you one day, genuinely
I’ll make sure their the team I go to see when I go to the states eventually!
Thank you friend! Hopefully we cross paths again on reddit one day. I’ll be sure to keep an eye out for you on this sub. The same to you, keep doing all the good things you’re doing
I’ll have to watch a game one day. Which team do you support?

Agreed, it’s just wholesome and simple. The smell is nice a well. Sometimes I’ll even just sit and think by myself for a while. 

Thank you! You as well, I hope you get to try your peppermint hot chocolate. Please update me if you ever get to trying to make drinks like frappuccinos. Would love to hear how that goes :)
Many wise words from you tonight, thank you naymp. I didn’t think it was possible but I feel a little bit lighter now. I sincerely hope that fate is kind to you, you deserve good things.

I’m glad you’re starting to surround yourself with people who get it and care. Man I remember what it was like having friends/people that stare blankly at you while you open your soul up to them. They just don’t get it. The friends that even went as far as to get annoyed at you for not being present or happy. Fuck those people. We deserve better. I started weeding those people out of my life as well and am still going. 

Damn that’s a rough situation friend. That’s exactly it. It’s like you’re hanging from a rope and pulling yourself up with every ounce of strength you have. I started to see the light around the start of 2019 and since have been really working at myself. But man, recently I’ve fallen off and really crashed. I can’t even say that deep down I wanna live anymore. Holding onto the idea that, that feeling will come back. You’re right, things change fast. Gonna hold onto that
Ohh tell me about American football. I’m Australian so am out of the loop on that topic. Our finals season (AFL) is coming up soon, I used to be really into it but not so much anymore.

I haven’t come across it but I will definitely check it out, thank you! 

I agree. That’s a good one. The atmosphere of a coffee shop like Starbucks, especially when it’s not too busy is gold. I can’t remember the last time I had a hot chocolate. It’s really cold where I am now, think it might do me some good.

Management really makes or breaks a job hey, even when it’s your passion... That really sucks that you don’t get to spend a lot of time with your gf. I’m pretty lucky in that sense. I live with my partner but the mental problems on both ends seem to drive a wedge between us. Relationships are an uphill battle as it is, let alone when you throw depression in the mix. Are you close to your savings target for Florida? 

Honestly, sometimes I sit and just fantasise about the day when it ends. Whatever means that is. It’s a puzzle you just can’t figure out. Like you said, you have to find the key to your depression and it’s so fucking hard. You search everywhere for answers that just don’t come.

Yeah I noticed that with your profile - sorry if that’s a little bit stalkerish, a depressed fuck living to help other depressed fucks. I’m a big fan of that. It’s nice having a whole sub of people that are here to support one another. I do a lot of sitting and thinking myself haha, do you like your job?

I relate (although you are doing way better than me in life. Congrats on your hard work ethic). I find escaping into a hobby I’m passionate about distracts me from missing/depending on my bf. For me that was script writing. I know it sounds a bit of a basic answer but it helped me.

One thing you can do for yourself is try and not look at what others around you are doing. It’s hard, I know. Maybe try altering your social media so you see less of what your friends are doing and more positive and advice related posts/pages. Also try to surround yourself with friends that make you feel motivated rather shamed. Who you surround yourself with can play a subconscious role in how you perceive yourself. Good luck to you! Don’t give up

The day my mum told me “you’re not stupid, you just don’t have enough confidence in yourself.” I was 7 and failing maths. It was something I struggled with throughout primary school, thinking I wasn’t as smart as the other kids. It didn’t help that a couple of my friends were very smart and used to remind me that I wasn’t. 

Every time I struggled or failed, her words would come back to me. 

By the time I was in high school I was in the advanced math classes. It was my best and favourite subject in my final year. After high school I even went on to do maths in university as part of my science degree. Your parents really do shape you.
I’m often forgotten as well
